title: Complete pure result
requirement: WHEN a pure value returns with no remaining frames, the interpreter SHALL expose that value as a completed pure result.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Completed versus pending
scenarios.when: The final list-sum return has value 6 and an empty frame stack.
scenarios.then: The result is Halted(6), distinct from an intermediate Return(6) with remaining frames.

expected.final: Halted(6) with an empty frame stack
expected.intermediate: Return with remaining frames is not a completed result
